title: Catch the answer
instructions: return hands an answer back. But someone has to catch it!
double_it(score); works out the answer and then drops it. score stays the same.
score = double_it(score); catches the answer and puts it in the box.
task: The score should go from 4 to 8. Fix it so the program prints:  Score: 8
hint:
Put the answer back in the box:

    score = double_it(score);
